newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Libyan envoy arrives in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Libyan envoy arrives in Morocco.

text.p: Libyan Secretary of Unity Affairs Jomaa al-Fezzani arrived to Morocco from Algeria where he had criticized the rapid intervention force set up last week by four European countries.

The Moroccan news agency MAP said on Friday that Fezzani arrived late on Thursday. It quoted him as saying on arrival that he carried a message from Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi to King Hassan on issues of common interest to the Maghreb Arab Union and the Mediterranean.
Fezzani has also visited Tunisia, another member of the Arab Maghreb Union.

Before meeting Algerian President Liamine Zeroual for whom he also carried a letter from Gaddafi, Fezzani told the Algerian news agency APS that the intervention force, Eurofor, "represents a danger and menace for the security, sovereignty and independence of the countries of the Arab Maghreb Union" .
The union consists of Algeria, Libya, Mauritania, Morocco and Tunisia.
